coverage_check: acknowledge every presented source alias and ground current-user evidence; an acknowledgement is not proof of correct understanding
review_evidence: exact uniquely located user quotes only; supported verdicts cite every user source cited by the candidate; assistant text remains context, never user-fact evidence
omissions: flag for reassessment, do not invent new items or count local completion as model recall
source_payload: bounded full role/content/source_ref/recorded_at view; omit owner, session, DB IDs, server hashes and reset/exclusion metadata
request_binding: opaque request_ref binds prompt, full source context/version, processing permissions and exact extraction response for review; it is not a save token
permissions_boundary: explicit trusted per-stage booleans and matching policy version; synthetic tests do not grant real processing permissions; R4 must recheck persistent authority
pure_new_preferences: default skips second request but remains pending_review/extraction_only_not_supported, not automatically saved or semantically approved; explicit review can be requested
review_required: health, mixed output, clarification, empty items or non-new-information relations

status_rules.no_memory: only an otherwise valid empty extraction plus complete coverage review; still a model judgment
status_rules.rejected: all supplied proposals contradicted; not converted to successful empty negative
status_rules.needs_reassessment: possible omission, unclear coverage, or unnecessary/unclear question
status_rules.needs_confirmation: unclear item or reviewed appropriate question, no save
status_rules.processing_failed: invalid structure, stale reply, bad quote or budget failure; never empty success

transport: not implemented; supplied offline replies only; no SDK, client, callbacks, database or automatic retries
response_handling: strict no-extra/no-duplicate-key/no-nonfinite JSON, exact duplicate questions rejected, atomic rejection on malformed item, review must cover every item/question, no verdict-based candidate rewriting
